functions.name: assign_audit_position
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assign_audit_position()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.audit_position SET value = value + 1 WHERE singleton RETURNING value INTO NEW.event_order;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.name: github_app_registrations_pending_once
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.github_app_registrations_pending_once()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF OLD.converted_at IS NOT NULL AND (
       NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id OR NEW.state_hash IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.state_hash
       OR NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.organization_id OR NEW.actor_identity_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.actor_identity_id
       OR NEW.consumed_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.consumed_at
       OR NEW.converted_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.converted_at OR NEW.pending_expires_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.pending_expires_at
       OR NEW.pending_github_app_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.pending_github_app_id OR NEW.pending_slug IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.pending_slug
       OR NEW.pending_client_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.pending_client_id OR NEW.pending_owner_login IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.pending_owner_login
       OR NEW.pending_owner_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.pending_owner_id OR NEW.pending_owner_type IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.pending_owner_type
       OR (NEW.pending_key_envelope IS NOT NULL AND NEW.pending_key_envelope IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.pending_key_envelope)
       OR (OLD.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.ended_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ended_at OR NEW.end_reason IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.end_reason))
     ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'a GitHub App registration''s pending conversion is written once and never updated'
      USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

passkey_counter_forward
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.passkey_counter_forward()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF (NEW.counter > 0 OR OLD.counter > 0) AND NEW.counter <= OLD.counter THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'passkey % signature counter % is not greater than the stored %', OLD.id, NEW.counter, OLD.counter
      USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation', CONSTRAINT = 'passkey_counter_forward';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.name: revoke_browser_credentials_of_ended_sessions
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.revoke_browser_credentials_of_ended_sessions()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.credentials c
   WHERE c.auth_session_id IN (SELECT e.id FROM ended e)
     AND c.kind = 'browser' AND c.revoked_at IS NULL
     AND (c.expires_at IS NULL OR c.expires_at > now())
   ORDER BY c.id
   FOR UPDATE OF c;
  WITH revoked AS (
    UPDATE public.credentials c SET revoked_at = now()
     WHERE c.auth_session_id IN (SELECT e.id FROM ended e)
       AND c.kind = 'browser' AND c.revoked_at IS NULL
       AND (c.expires_at IS NULL OR c.expires_at > now())
    RETURNING c.id, c.identity_id
  )
  INSERT INTO public.audit_events (id, schema_version, event_type, decision, credential_id, resource, metadata)
  SELECT public.new_audit_event_id(), 1, 'credential.revoked', 'info', r.id,
         jsonb_build_object('identityId', r.identity_id),
         jsonb_build_object('kind', 'browser', 'reason', 'session-ended')
    FROM revoked r
   ORDER BY r.id;
  RETURN NULL;
END $function$
